assessmentQuestions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of searching in a Balanced Binary Search Tree (such as an AVL or Red-Black Tree) containing N elements?
In React, what hook should be used to memoize expensive computations between re-renders when dependencies have not changed?
Which HTTP status code signifies that the client must authenticate themselves to get the requested response?
In relational database transactions, what does the "I" in ACID stand for?
In Docker, what instruction in a Dockerfile defines the default executable that will run when the container starts?
What mathematical technique is commonly used to prevent overfitting in neural networks by penalizing large weights?
In TypeScript, what type keyword is used to create a new type representing values that can be either of two types (A | B)?
In microservices architecture, which design pattern allows independent services to communicate asynchronously without direct dependencies?
When a critical milestone is delayed due to an unexpected technical roadblock in your peer module, what is the best immediate step?
options: Wait silently until the daily standup next week.
Proactively communicate the roadblock to the team lead and collaborate with the peer to troubleshoot.
Blame the peer so your individual rating remains unaffected.
Abandon that part of the project unilaterally.

assessmentQuestions.question: Two senior team members disagree strongly on which architectural framework to adopt. How should you facilitate resolution?
options: Force an immediate coin toss decision.
Organize a structured trade-off matrix session evaluating scalability, maintainability, and delivery timelines against project requirements.
Pick the choice of the loudest person.

assessmentQuestions.question: When presenting a quarterly technical report to non-technical industry stakeholders, what is most effective?
options: Use dense academic equations and deep kernel code listings without context.
Focus on business impact, key reliability metrics, user outcomes, and visual milestone summaries.

assessmentQuestions.question: Midway through development, client specifications change drastically due to a newly announced government compliance regulation. How should you adapt?
options: Refuse to adapt and insist on the old specifications.
Analyze the compliance changes, reassess scope with stakeholders, and reprioritize sprint backlog items methodically.
Panic and scrap all existing documentation.

assessmentQuestions.question: If "DATA" is encoded as "ECWB", how is "CODE" encoded using the same pattern?
A cloud server processes 1,200 requests per minute. If auto-scaling increases capacity by 25% every 10 minutes, how many requests can it process per minute after 20 minutes?
In a university placement drive of 500 students, 60% are eligible for IT roles, and 40% of the eligible candidates receive final offers. How many students receive offers?
Premise 1: All accredited engineering colleges offer AI training. Premise 2: College X offers AI training. Can we definitively conclude College X is accredited?
options: No, this is the fallacy of affirming the consequent; other non-accredited entities may also offer AI training.
Only if College X has a NIRF rank.
